items.title: Intuit (INTU) is Lowering TurboTax Revenue per User to Win Customers. Can the Strategy Restore Double-Digit Growth?
items.summary: Intuit Inc. (NASDAQ:INTU) expects growth to slow after reporting a strong fiscal 2026. Revenue increased 14% to $21.4 billion, but fiscal 2027 guidance calls for only 9% to 10% growth, including just 2% to 3% growth at TurboTax. Intuit Inc. items.title: INTU Q2 Deep Dive: AI Strategy and Customer Acquisition Take Center Stage
items.summary: Financial technology platform Intuit (NASDAQ:INTU) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 13.7% year on year to $4.35 billion. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $4.31 billion was less impressive, coming in 1.3% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.03 per share was 12.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Intuit faces AI-driven growth pressure as BofA cuts rating to Neutral
items.summary: Investing.com -- Intuit is heading into a transition year as artificial intelligence reshapes demand for its tax products and weaker customer growth raises concerns about the pace of expansion, BofA Securities said on Wednesday, cutting its rating on the financial software company to Neutral from Buy.

items.summary: Stocks traded modestly lower Wednesday ahead of Nvidia’s earnings report and after the personal consumption expenditures index, or PCE, for July revealed inflation was a bit stronger than expected.  Intel  rose o.9% and  Broadcom  declined 0.3% with investors in wait-and-see mode when it comes to chip stocks.  Nvidia  reported earnings after the bell, and shares rose about 4%.
